messages:
Marta Alvarez: tagging the group for DeepCore XPU-4 preview coordination. Partner signed NDA (see: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/DEEPCORE-NDA). Need to agree on bench matrix, telemetry, and an embargo window by Thu.
Ethan Li: Got it. Can we get images and firmware by Tue? want to test with our runtime branch `rc/xpu-4-compat`.
Ravi Patel: Legal Bot flagged export control clause C. Partner confirmed no restricted cryptography. Legal Bot: NDA status: signed; export check: OK; redlines accepted.
Marta Alvarez: Perfect. Marketplace Team, do we have a draft listing that avoids GA language? Partner wants "preview" wording + partner badge.
Marketplace Team: We have a draft. Will replace "available now" with "preview access" and remove revenue numbers. Uploading to /drive/marketplace/deepcore/xpu4-listing-draft.md
Ethan Li: For benchmarking, propose the following matrix: models=[rwd-13b,rwd-70b], context=[4k,32k], modes=[fp16,quant8]. Targets for preview: rwd-13b p50<60ms p95<220ms @4k; rwd-70b p50<140ms p95<420ms @4k. Thoughts?
Ravi Patel: Add cold-start measurements and a memory-pressure fallback to `xpu4-quant8`. Also include sustained QPS sweep to catch thermal throttling.
Marta Alvarez: Infra Lab, can you reserve bench time? partner prefers Wed night UTC.
Infra Lab: Reserved slots: Wed 23:00-02:00 UTC and Thu 05:00-09:00 UTC. Please upload bench configs to https://drive.redwood/apps/deepcore/eap-configs.
Ethan Li: I'll push harness config now. Command to run (dev): `./ci/run_perf --target xpu4 --model rwd-13b --ctx 4096 --mode fp16 --warmup 800 --samples 200`. Will also include `--cold-start` flag for separate runs.
Marta Alvarez: Telemetry plan: sample 1% token traces, collect prefix cache hit/miss, and emit p50/p95/p99. Jon from runtime suggested prefix K/V visibility.
Ravi Patel: That sampling sounds fine. Ensure telemetry is anonymized (no prompt text). Legal Bot: Confirmed telemetry plan meets privacy constraints.
Marketplace Team: Quick note on listing assets: partner supplied logos; Legal Bot requires trademark clearance. Please use `deepcore_logo_approved.svg`.
Ethan Li: Ops ask: include a runtime fallback policy to `rwd-13b-compact` for shared preview pools. Config snippet for runtime:```json
{"fallback_policy":"compact_on_mem_pressure","metrics_tag":"deepcore-xpu4-eap"}
```
Marta Alvarez: Embargo/announce cadence: partner requested internal soft mention after successful bench + public co-announcement 10 days after GA. We should lock a provisional public date only after bench artifacts are uploaded.
Infra Lab: Bench artifacts will be stored under /runs/DEEPCORE-EAP-9912. We will attach raw logs + flamegraphs.
Ethan Li: Action items: 1) push harness + config (Due: Tue EOD) 2) run bench in reserved slots (Wed/Thu) 3) upload artifacts + heatmaps (Due: Thu EOD).
Ravi Patel: I'll prepare the fallback binary (`xpu4-quant8`) and a quick smoke test for memory spikes.
Marketplace Team: I'll finalize listing copy and screenshots. Will not claim GA. Draft link: https://drive.redwood/marketplace/drafts/deepcore-xpu4-v1.md
Marta Alvarez: Great. We also need to confirm PR talking points with partner; I'll own that. Can we have a short sync Tue 11:00 PT?
Ethan Li: Works for me.
Ravi Patel: Works.
Infra Lab: bench job queued: job_id=DC-EAP-9912, eta Wed 23:00 UTC. Logs at /runs/DC-EAP-9912.
Marta Alvarez: Thanks all 680. If anyone hits a blocker (images, firmware, legal) call it out here so we can escalate to partner EM.
